laws.rule: Ras Al Hadd/Ras Al Jinz Turtle Reserve: Oman's official visitor guidance asks visitors to keep a safe distance from turtles, avoid bright lights and flash photography, and leave eggs undisturbed. This is the published conservation guidance, not a claim that a particular permit or night-entry procedure was checked.

sources.title: Experience Oman: Ras Al Hadd turtle visitor guidance
sources.authority: Ministry of Heritage and Tourism, Oman
sources.supports: Read directly: keep a safe distance, avoid bright lights and flash photography and do not disturb turtle eggs.
